newsitem.title: USA: Cabletron founder, CEO Levine to resign-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Cabletron founder, CEO Levine to resign-WSJ.

text.p: Cabletron Systems Inc founder, president and chief executive S. Robert Levine will voluntarily resign from the company at a news conference on Wednesday, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
Cabletron will announce that a company insider will fill the positions, the paper said. The name of that person is not yet known, the paper added.
Analysts said Levine's resignation will mean Cabletron can now concentrate its efforts on regaining the market share it has lost in recent years.
Levine founded the company in his garage in 1983.
